summary: A campaign worker stays at the home office and sends material to colleagues traveling with the candidate.
realLife: David Stowe recalled helping supply the 1948 train from Washington while Clifford and George Elsey worked aboard it; Stowe himself did not ride that campaign train.
inGame: needs: staff assignments and a way to deliver copy.

turns.pulledBy: A question reaches the office in time.
turns.what: The researcher sends the finding to the traveling staff.
turns.writesBack: The worker contributes without being at the stop.

turns.pulledBy: A traveling aide needs a fact the office cannot confirm.
turns.writesBack: The candidate can speak without using it.
